=== Possibly faulty data and open points ===
* KingFelix (Shadow 69) real name not known
* Anakin Solo signed as Shadow 57 (Aug 2005) while the Dec 2005 roster gives Shadow 57 to Michael Wages; same person not confirmed
* Steve Jones signed Shadow 47 (captured Feb 2005); the June 2004 roster gave Shadow 47 to Duane Bruun
* John Anderson (Shadow 29, Atlanta): his wiki page also describes a Minnesota/North Dakota player (puck71, 1982-2018); looks like two people merged on one page, needs disambiguation
